description: Helena at monitors, surgical gaze (character introduction)
lessons_learned: v1: 'monitors' in prompt → camera orbits behind subject (0.92→0.27 collapse)

v3: remove all monitor context → stable but neon eyes from 'blue light reflection'
v4: 'natural eye color, soft even lighting, no colored light' → correct
prompt_template: Pure portrait, natural dark brown eyes, soft even studio lighting, no colored light on face, no glow. Static portrait with camera locked.
